rule: Territory, visitor levy and Fund
review_note: Complete §§1–2 provide visitor/Fund purpose and land/internal-water territory; Jan Mayen not included.

rule: Resident levy prohibition
review_note: §78 resident prohibition checked with §3(i) definition and neighbouring fund provisions.

rule: Resident exemption/refund
review_note: §4 resident exemption/refund checked against statutory valid-population-register definition.

rule: Population register identifies eligible residents
review_note: Register eligibility is explicit; not inferred from income-tax residence.

rule: NOK150 ticket levy
review_note: NOK150 ordinary ticket charge; conditions and exceptions accompany rule.

rule: Air collection on departure ticket and incorporated exceptions
review_note: Air collection on ticket from Svalbard and incorporated tariff exceptions identified; current exceptions expressly unverified, no age waiver invented.

rule: Private boat NOK150 and notification
review_note: NOK150 own-boat notification-linked charge; Governor separately confirms private-boat visitor self-payment.

rule: Three-year claim clock
review_note: Claim must be made within three years after actual travel, not booking date.

rule: Special-reasons dispensation
review_note: Ministry special-reasons dispensation is discretionary; actual grant needed.

rule: Air/cruise ticket collection and private boat self-payment
review_note: Expanded Governor accordion confirms airline/cruise ticket collection and private-boat own payment.

rule: Private boat payment official account publication
review_note: Governor publishes Fund account/IBAN; Guide points to official current details without inventing payment reference.

rule: Completed outward-travel evidence
review_note: Completed journey from Svalbard evidence, boarding pass or other confirmation; unused booking insufficient.

rule: Personal form excludes employer/NAV/Patient Travel paid trips
review_note: Personal form excludes employer/NAV/Pasientreiser/similar paid travel.

rule: Employer agreement and separate form
review_note: Employer written agreements and separate employer form to tax office; no automatic employer entitlement asserted.

rule: Tax office administers refund
review_note: Tax office administers refund and contact route published; no promised processing time.

rule: Coercive fine through Act96
review_note: Coercive fine power verified with Act§96 context: decision-specific, correction clock and impossibility exception; Guide does not supply automatic daily amount.

rule: Intentional/negligent infringement fines
review_note: Intentional/negligent infringement fine power verified; no fixed amount invented.

rule: Published form title and initial access choices only; no post-access fields verified
act_article: Official refund form initial screen, browser observation
review_note: Independent normal-browser initial screen confirms title, unchecked privacy acceptance and three access choices. Separate UI labels, not a statutory sentence. No acceptance/login/open-without-login/submission.

rule: Only duties actually imposed activate Act machinery
review_note: Conditional enabling Act: other minerals require actual charging decision; 2026 decision is coal only.

rule: Exporter liability and seasonal achieved average FOB
review_note: Whole shipping season and achieved average FOB per tonne; not invoice-by-invoice rate reset.

rule: CIF freight/insurance; actual charter costs; discretionary own-ship or unknown freight
review_note: CIF paid freight/insurance; hired/time-chartered actual cost; own ships or unascertainable expense require discretionary freight.

rule: Actual own/hired/time-chartered ship bunker exemption
review_note: Bunker exemption requires exporter actual use in own/hired/time-chartered vessel; resale for a buyer fuel use is insufficient.

rule: Shipment security can be required; no invented percentage
review_note: Quote verified in complete §2, but shipment-security power omitted from Guide body and reservations: F1.

rule: Book contents, evidence,31December, Norwegian representative
review_note: Book content, prescribed form/evidence, 31 December, and Norwegian representative recorded; unverified filing interface declared.

rule: Producer corresponding joint liability, separate accounts and31December
review_note: Producer jointly responsible only for corresponding duty share; separate accounts by same 31 December. Not a second tax.

rule: Tax office assesses and can require further information
review_note: Tax office calculates assessment and producer shares and can request more information; workpaper is not assessment.

rule: Record/information failure can bar appeal; sufficient-excuse exception
review_note: Failure can bar appeal; sufficient-excuse exception preserved, including producer failures.

rule: Registered calculation letter or statutory office-availability event
review_note: Registered dispatch to Norwegian address or office availability for nonresident/no-representative case; not actual receipt clock.

rule: Appeal received within6weeks; extension by application
review_note: Appeal must arrive within six weeks of dispatch/availability; extension only on application.

rule: Tax appeals board and further statement
review_note: Unaccepted appeal referred to Svalbard tax appeals board with further statement opportunity.

rule: Payment within6weeks
review_note: Payment clock separately six weeks from dispatch/availability.

rule: Overdue amount at leastNOK100; annually set rate
review_note: Interest condition is overdue duty at least NOK100 and an annually determined rate; rate expressly unverified.

rule: Appeal does not suspend payment; excess refunded
review_note: Appeal does not suspend payment; reduced final decision entails repayment of excess.

rule: Supplementary assessment and30April interest start
review_note: Ministry-request supplementary assessment after wholly/substantially escaped assessment; interest starts 30 April payment year.

rule: 5year/10year request clocks and2year death/dissolution condition
review_note: Five-year request clock from assessment-year end, ten for criminal conduct; death/dissolution two-year outer condition only inside unexpired period.

rule: Enforceability
review_note: Enforcement basis verified; Guide gives no invented fixed execution charge.

rule: Fines for book/account/information failures
review_note: Fines attach to specified record/information failures, no flat amount invented.
